args.query: OpenAI Python SDK structured outputs parsed into a Pydantic model

results.title: OpenAI Python SDK structured outputs, tested with respx
results.summary: Call the OpenAI Python SDK and validate JSON output with Pydantic, testing success, malformed output and API errors offline by mocking HTTP with respx.

results.title: OpenAI chat.completions.parse with Pydantic output + respx mocks
results.summary: Get typed output from OpenAI chat.completions.parse using a Pydantic response_format, handle refusals and schema mismatches, and test offline with respx returning canned JSON.

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK tool calling + Zod, tested with a mocked fetch
results.summary: Run an OpenAI chat tool-calling loop with Zod-validated tool arguments, tested offline by injecting a fake fetch into the official SDK.

results.title: OpenAI Node SDK streaming chat completions, tested with a mocked SSE fetch
results.summary: Stream chat completion deltas with the OpenAI SDK (for await over chunks), accumulate text and usage, and handle aborts, tested offline with a fake fetch that returns an SSE body.

results.title: LangChain (Python) LCEL chain with structured parsing, tested with a fake chat model
results.summary: Compose ChatPromptTemplate, a chat model and a Pydantic output parser with LCEL in langchain-core, tested offline using GenericFakeChatModel.

results.title: Loading .env files with python-dotenv and pydantic-settings precedence rules
results.summary: Typed app settings from .env files with pydantic-settings, covering source precedence, layered env files, extra-key rules and python-dotenv override behavior, tested offline with tmp_path files.

results.title: orjson + Pydantic v2 model round trip
results.summary: Serialize Pydantic v2 models to bytes with orjson through a default fallback and option flags, then validate them back offline with TypeAdapter.

results.title: DeepDiff diffing of pydantic v2 model dumps with ignore_order
results.summary: Compare pydantic v2 model dumps with DeepDiff, normalizing python vs json dump modes and taming list order, datetime and float gotchas.

results.title: feedparser XML fixtures into pydantic v2 models
results.summary: Convert RSS and Atom feeds parsed by feedparser, including struct_time dates and tags, into validated pydantic v2 models with offline XML fixtures.

results.title: FastAPI + Pydantic v2 validators, discriminated unions and serializers
results.summary: Pydantic v2 patterns in FastAPI that agents often get wrong: field_validator, model_validator, discriminated unions, computed_field and response_model filtering.
